Order
 Order No. 07.11.2025
 1. 1.
This mater is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Petitioner in this writ petition prays for a direction to pay him due compensation for acquisition of his land in Plot No. 201/360 under Khata No. 48/1 area Ac.0.325 decimal out of land Ac.l.00 decimal situated in Mouza Phalpaju under Daspalla tahasil in the district of Nayagarh (for brevity,
'the case land') for Khordha-Bolangir Rail Link.
3. In course of hearing, Mr. Acharya, learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the compensation awarded for acquisition of his land is meagre.
The Petitioner was not paid the statutory interest for acquisition.

He was also not extended with other benefits under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettleme nt Act, 2013 (for brevity, 'the Act').

Mr. Mishra, learned ASC submits that the Petitioner had earlier approached this Court in W.P.(C)
No.16415 of 2022 for the similar relief, which was disposed of on 21st July, 2022 with a direction to the Collector, Nayagarh for disposal of his representation.
There is no averment with regard to W.P.(C) No.16415 of 2022 in the present writ petition.
The status of such representation, which was directed to be disposed of, is also not stated in the present writ petition.
Further, the instant writ petition is not maintainable as the Petitioner had statutory remedy for the relief claimed in the present writ petition.
He, therefore, prays for dismissal of the writ petition.

5. Mr. Acharya, learned counsel for the Petitioner, however, fairly submits that the Petitioner had earlier approached this Court in W.P.(C) No.16415 of 2022 for the similar relief, which was disposed of on 21st July, 2022 directing the Collector, Nayagarh to dispose of his representation.

6. In view of the above submissions of learned counsel for the parties, this Court finds that for similar nature of relief, the Petitioner had already approached this Court in W.P.(C) No.16415 of 2022.
Thus, the present writ petition is not maintainable.
7. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed.
Dismissal of the writ petition, however, shall not be a bar for the Petitioner to work out the remedy, if any available under law.
